title: Speak vs. Know: Balancing Behavior and Knowledge Distributions of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the distributional alignment of LLM generated survey responses with the ground-truth opinion distributions of political groups (Democrat and Republican) using the OpinionQA and NYT Book Opinions datasets.

Evaluating the distributional alignment of LLM generated survey responses with the ground-truth opinion distributions of gender demographic groups (Male and Female) using the OpinionQA and NYT Book Opinions datasets.
Evaluating the distributional alignment of LLM generated survey responses with the ground-truth opinion distributions of racial groups (Black and White) using the OpinionQA dataset.

Measuring the distributional alignment of LLM outputs against survey responses from different countries and regions using the GlobalOpinionQA dataset and the World Values Survey (WVS), as well as evaluating everyday cultural knowledge using the BLEnD benchmark.
